annotations.title: Send the build files git doesn't have

description: Finds the files a build on GitHub reads that git doesn't have (the app config's googleServicesFile for Android and iOS, and the .env files Expo loads) in this checkout, and sends those that aren't in Ploa yet or differ from its copy (or the paths given). They wait sealed in Ploa's vault until the person approves them on ploa.dev with one tap; not approved within 24 hours, they're dropped. Tell the person to approve, with the link this returns, and follow it with ploa_approval_status. The files' values never pass through here: only names, sizes and a .env's variable names. Signing and store keys are never build files (Ploa keeps them already). google-services.json and GoogleService-Info.plist aren't secret, so committing them is the other way.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

paths.description: Files to send, relative to the app's folder. Default: those the build will miss.

name: ploa_build_files_push
